axes.concept: Review known estimated AI spend as a compact operational ledger within the existing staff administration surface.
axes.layout: One full-width rounded paper: user/kind filters, a ruled three-value totals strip, five grouping controls, then aligned records; session and work details replace only the paper contents.
axes.navigation: Retain the sibling masthead and neutral administration route rule. Five in-page grouping buttons use one moving underline; session and work rows drill into contextual detail with a summary return. Employee fixture omits unrelated account-management destinations.
axes.typography: Existing embedded Geist Sans: 24px page title, 18–20px section headings, 14px records, 12–13px metadata, and tabular 28–32px totals. Geist Mono is confined to technical identifiers.
axes.density: Compact ruled rows in one shared panel rather than KPI cards or a separate inspector. Desktop filters use 2:1:auto columns; at 640–1099px they wrap; below 640px rows reflow into labelled value pairs and the estimated cost spans the totals strip.
axes.components: Installed shadcn/Base UI Button and Skeleton composed with labelled native selects, semantic tables, details/summary conversation disclosures and the existing account disclosure vocabulary.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures globals.css tokens mapped to kit roles in both themes, including the sibling accessible texto-tenue input edge. Accent marks drill-in actions; neutral underline identifies grouping; warning/error tokens identify partial/billable-error metadata.
axes.motion: Precise quick registration: finite 320ms paper and 10px row movements with 28ms offsets, 160ms controls, 180ms moving group marker; natural/subtle profiles shorten timings. Reduced motion, Quieto and still show settled content; hidden tabs pause CSS motion.
